title: Black Garlic and Porcini Chicken Thighs
description: Bagless chicken thighs are folded into a dark porcini gravy whose sweetness comes from black garlic.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with bottom drip pan, wire rack and food probe
Heatproof measuring jug and coffee filter

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Use plain, unenhanced poultry. Remove visible fat before weighing.

ingredients.name: dried porcini mushrooms
ingredients.note: Plain and unsalted. Remove before serving.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain chicken-and-water broth without a vegetable blend or added seasoning.

ingredients.name: black garlic puree
ingredients.note: Choose pure black garlic without added salt.

steps.title: Set the APO
steps.text: Fill the tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 185°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 175°F.

steps.title: Load the thighs
steps.text: Unfold {chicken} in a single layer in the pan on the middle rack, unbagged. Insert the probe sideways into the thickest center. Start the full-steam cook and set a 30-minute reminder.

steps.title: Steep the porcini
steps.text: While the thighs cook, bring {broth} just to a boil in the HexClad. Pour it over {porcini} in a heatproof jug, cover and steep for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Filter the mushroom liquor
steps.text: Lift out the softened mushrooms and reserve them for another use. Pour the soaking liquid through a damp coffee filter into the skillet, leaving the gritty sediment in the jug.

steps.title: Infuse the gravy
steps.text: Whisk {garlic} into the mushroom liquor. Add {thyme} and simmer for 4–6 minutes until the liquid measures about 5/8 cup per serving. Remove the thyme.

steps.title: Bind the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and let it bubble gently for 1 minute, stirring until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Check the chicken
steps.text: Begin checking at 30 minutes from loading. Pull each thigh at 175°F in its thickest center, typically 35–65 minutes total. Rest loosely covered in its juices for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Coat the slices
steps.text: Swirl {butter} into the gravy off heat. Slice the thighs across the grain and turn the slices through the gravy, spooning the rest around each serving.

notes: Sauce yield: About 1 1/4 cups for two. Make ahead: The filtered porcini broth can be made a day ahead and chilled. Whisk in the black garlic when you cook the chicken. For dairy-free gravy, omit the finishing butter. Chill leftovers promptly in shallow portions and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze thin slices submerged in their gravy for up to 2 months; the mushroom base holds its flavor. Fridge reheat: Transfer one portion with its gravy to a shallow covered oven-safe dish. Install the bottom drip pan and preheat the APO to 325°F with sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Set the food probe to 165°F at the coldest center. Check after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then follow the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 221 kcal, 29.9 g protein, 5.9 g total carbohydrate, 7.8 g fat, 0.2 g fiber, 165 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
